rulings.S1_fee: 0.07 x C x p x (1 - p), rounded UP to the cent per order, C = 1 (quadratic, multiplier 1, standard schedule); the unrounded figure is information only
rulings.S2_sd: consecutive bar pairs both present on F_now's instrument id, at least 6 of the 10, sample (n - 1) sd, times sqrt(119/60)
rulings.S3_quote: the decision candle's YES bid and ask closes; YES bid + NO bid >= 1 - 1e-9 (crossed or locked) is no quote (rule 18)
rulings.S4_tie: a tie of the two asks goes to YES; the tie count is printed
rulings.S5_thirds: three equal time spans from 2026-12-01T00:00Z to the last traded close at or before READ_DATE
rulings.S6_void: a void is a fee-only loss; an empty result stops the run
rulings.Z_event: z clustered by event ticker (Head of R&D, Nov 13, 16:51Z): mean of the per-event summed net over the sample sd of those sums times sqrt(number of events); under 2 events or a zero sd, no z; the held verdict needs z >= 5.46
